summary: Re-test of iteration 54's CRITICAL flag (half-applied OpenAI max_completion_tokens fix). Verified the new module-level helper `_openai_token_kwargs(model, n)` is now invoked at BOTH OpenAI call sites in freebuild_agent.py (lines 8696 and 9468), and the Anthropic call at line 8463 is correctly preserved with `max_tokens=8000`. All 12 unit tests pass (including strengthened source-introspection), all 69 regression tests pass (test_ai_mode 19 + test_surgical_fixes 26 + test_surgical_fixes_v2 24), and runtime import-and-call verification on the live helper returned the correct dict for all 10 model patterns (gpt-5.5/5.4/5.2/5/o1/o3/o4-mini -> max_completion_tokens; gpt-4o/gpt-4.1/moonshot-v1 -> max_tokens). Helper has a complete docstring covering the GPT-5/o-series requirement.
